## Validation flags

A trip is **valid** when none of these flags is raised. Flags overlap, so they do not add up to the excluded total.

| Flag | Trips | Share of raw |
|---|---:|---:|
| `missing_origin` | 0 | 0.00% |
| `missing_dest` | 1 | 0.00% |
| `unknown_station` | 176 | 0.01% |
| `missing_time` | 0 | 0.00% |
| `end_before_start` | 0 | 0.00% |
| `duration_mismatch` | 8 | 0.00% |
| `too_short` | 0 | 0.00% |
| `too_long` | 7,779 | 0.25% |
| `outside_year` | 0 | 0.00% |
| `duplicate_id` | 0 | 0.00% |
| `duplicate_logical` | 0 | 0.00% |

Rules:

- `missing_origin` / `missing_dest`: station identifier empty.
- `unknown_station`: identifier never observed with a valid coordinate.
- `duration_mismatch`: reported `duracion_recorrido` differs from end − start by more than 60 s.
- `too_short`: under 60 s (dock tests, immediate re-docking). `too_long`: over 4 h (lost or unreturned bikes, not mobility).
- `outside_year`: trip starts outside 2025. Trips that *end* in early 2026 are kept.
- `duplicate_id`: repeated `Id_recorrido`. `duplicate_logical`: same user, origin and start time.

Raw duration distribution (seconds): count=3,156,182, mean=1,378, std=5,720, min=61, 1%=125, 50%=969, 99%=6,686, max=2,481,476.
Durations in the source use a thousands separator (`"3,258"` = 3,258 s); they match the timestamps.
The shortest raw duration is 61 s, which indicates that the publisher already removes sub-minute trips.

## Stations

- Station coordinates are taken from the trip records. 222 of 6,312,363 station references carried missing or `0,0` coordinates and were ignored.
- 19 stations appear with more than one coordinate during the year; the most frequent position is used. 14 of them moved more than 100 m (relocations).
- Station names are normalised by removing the numeric prefix (`"146 - Hospital Francés"` → `"Hospital Francés"`).

|---|---|---|

| Bike model | `modelo_bicicleta` (FIT / ICONIC) | all trips |

**Age caveats.** Each yearly user file lists the users who *registered* that year, with their age at registration.
Age in 2025 is estimated as age at registration + years since registration. 1,098,439 user records were read;
93.7% of trips matched one. 1,690 trips had an implausible estimated age
(outside 16–90) and their age was set to missing. Users not found in any file (e.g. registered before
2015 or absent from the publication) have no age. **Age results describe the matched subset only.**

| Age group | Trips |
|---|---:|
| 16-24 | 724,197 |
| 25-34 | 876,932 |
| 35-44 | 653,853 |
| 45-54 | 421,393 |
| 55-64 | 208,944 |
| 65+ | 70,036 |
| nan | 200,827 |

## Privacy safeguards

- User identifiers are used only for the age join and are **never** written to the web data.
- Published demographic breakdowns suppress any cell with fewer than `MIN_CELL` trips (see `pipeline/config.py`).
- Only aggregated tables are published; no row-level trip data leaves `data/processed/`.
